**1 — Scene:** A meal of browned chicken slices, seasoned rice, leafy salad, cooked green vegetables and a section of corn on the cob.

**2 — Vessel:** A large, roughly square dinner plate, partly cropped. Using a **26 cm equivalent diameter**, its estimated area is **3.14 × 13² = 531 cm²**.

**3 — Items:** Chicken; orange seasoned rice; spinach/mixed salad leaves; mixed vegetables, apparently Brussels sprouts, broccoli and peppers; corn. No separate pool of sauce or dressing is visible. Cooking fat is included in the chicken and rice energy estimates.

**4–7 — Area, volume, weight and energy:**

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Estimated weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Browned chicken slices | 18% | 96 cm² × 1.5 cm = 144 ml | 0.95 g/ml | 137 g | 190 | 260 kcal |
| Seasoned rice | 14% | 74 cm² × 2 cm = 148 ml | 0.8 g/ml | 118 g | 160 | 189 kcal |
| Leafy salad | 24% | 127 cm² × 2.5 cm = 318 ml | 0.13 g/ml | 41 g | 23 | 9 kcal |
| Mixed vegetables | 7% | 37 cm² × 1.8 cm = 67 ml | 0.6 g/ml | 40 g | 45 | 18 kcal |
| Corn section | 7% | 37 cm² × 3 cm = 111 ml | 0.6 g/ml | 67 g | 96 | 64 kcal |

The areas total **70% of the plate**, consistent with the substantial empty space on the left. The corn estimate represents the edible portion approximately; the cob is not counted as food weight.

**8 — Sanity check:** Approximately **403 g and 540 kcal** is plausible for the visible meal: a moderate chicken portion, a small rice serving, bulky but light leaves, and vegetables. Cropping, pile depth and cooking oil introduce uncertainty; roughly **330–490 g and 440–670 kcal** is a reasonable range.
